svg.text: Python is call by object reference (also called call by assignment). For immutable values —

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: int, float, str, bool, tuple — the result LOOKS exactly like pass by value, because rebinding

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: a name can never reach back into the caller.
